shop:title: Shop
shop:intro: Spend the coins you've earned. None of it makes the learning easier — that part is the same for everyone.
shop:intro__note: Sets the rule the whole shop obeys: coins buy delight, never advantage. Says it plainly rather than in a policy nobody reads.
shop:section.titles__note: Section heading. A title appears under your name on Profile. Max 14 characters.
shop:section.soon__note: Heading over the not-yet-buyable categories. Never a fake row that looks purchasable.
shop:soon.body: Pets, avatar items and map skins are being drawn. They'll appear here — nothing you buy now becomes worse when they do.
shop:soon.body__note: Honest about what is missing and why, and reassures that buying today is not a mistake. Never a countdown or a pre-order.
shop:balance__note: The user's coin balance in the header. ICU plural.
shop:price__note: Price on a shop row. Same shape as the balance so the two are comparable at a glance.
shop:owned__note: Replaces the price on something already bought. Never 'Buy again'. Max 10 characters.
shop:equipped__note: Marks the title currently shown on Profile. Max 10 characters.
shop:wear__note: Equips an owned title. Max 12 characters.
shop:remove__note: Unequips, returning to the level title. Max 14 characters.
shop:short: {count, plural, one {# coin to go} other {# coins to go}}
shop:short__note: Shown instead of Buy when they cannot afford it. A fact, stated once. NEVER an offer to buy coins — this app does not sell them — and never a countdown or a nag.
shop:levelTitle__note: The always-available option at the top of the titles list — the one earned by learning. Max 20 characters.
shop:levelTitle.help: Earned by levelling up, and always yours. It goes up as you learn.
shop:levelTitle.help__note: Explains that the free option is not the lesser one. Buying a title is a different hat, not an upgrade.
shop:empty.title: Nothing to buy yet
shop:empty.title__note: Empty state, shown if the catalogue is unreadable. Max 22 characters.
shop:empty.body: Your coins are safe. Come back when there's something here.
shop:empty.body__note: Empty state body. The fear is that earned coins vanished; answer it first.
shop:offline.body: You're offline, so buying is paused. Everything you own still works.
shop:offline.body__note: Offline state. A purchase is a server decision (ADR 0006), so it waits — but owned items are local and unaffected. Never reads as an error.
shop:title.flagFanatic__note: Purchasable title. Flavour, never rank — the level ladder in titles.json is earned and must stay earned. Max 18 characters.
shop:title.nightOwl__note: Purchasable title, for someone who learns late. Max 18 characters.
shop:title.earlyBird__note: Purchasable title, for someone who learns early. Max 18 characters.
shop:title.mapNerd__note: Purchasable title. Affectionate, never an insult — check it reads as a badge in every locale. Max 18 characters.
shop:balance.label: Your coins
shop:balance.label__note: Label above the coin balance on the shop wallet card. Max 14 characters.
